name: card_mini_icon_and_text
title: Card Mini Icon And Text
summary: Small card with icon and short text, single or grid.
description: Small card with an svg icon and a short text, optional link and background image. Variants: "row" (icon badge + text + arrow, link tiles) and "stack" (centered icon over text on an image). Renders one card, or a grid of cards from "items".
